口惜しいですな……
ダヤン様がこのような動きを見せること、
text.official_en: This is all rather frustrating.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ

text.jp:
このボナパルテの頭脳をもってしても、
読み切れておりませんでした。
text.official_en:
For all my wisdom, I failed to foresee that Prince
Dyan could pose any threat.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
いかにダヤン様とはいえ、今のサラミス国内で
何か事を起こすことは難しい筈なのですが……
text.official_en:
Though I daresay his options for causing us grief
are limited, even for a prince.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ボナパルテ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ひとまず、宰相のほうには、国内の動きに
目を光らせておくよう指示しておきました。
text.official_en:
For now, I have instructed the chancellor to keep a
close eye on developments.

text.jp:
くっそー、一難去ってまた一難かー。
せっかくお嬢の腕がどうにかなったってのに。
text.official_en:
Damn it! It's one problem after another. And just
when we'd got your arm thing solved too.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トビヤス

text.jp:
いったいどうなっとるんじゃ。
いくらなんでも厄介がたて続き過ぎと違うか？
text.official_en:
Seriously, what's the deal? Haven't we been through
enough at this point?

text.jp: ――はっ！？　これはもしや……
text.official_en: Wait... You don't think...

text.jp:
ここんとこ、ワシがユ・ファス様への
祈りをさぼっとったせいじゃあるまいのー！？
text.official_en:
This isn't because I've been slacking on my prayers
to Yu Phas, is it?

text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ダヤンさまがコットス要塞から逃げ出して
姿をくらましちゃったって話、ホントですか！？
text.official_en:
Is it true that Prince Dyan escaped from Fort Cottus
and went into hiding?
text.real_en:
Is it true that Dayan-sama escaped from Fort Cottus
and went into hiding?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン

text.jp:
いえ……アタシ個人は、ダヤンさまには
別にそんなに、思い入れはないんです……ケド、
text.official_en:
Don't get me wrong, I don't have any personal
attachment to the guy.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
うちの両親が、またダヤンさまの側につくなんて
馬鹿なこと考えないか、不安になったんです。
text.official_en:
But I worry that my parents might do something
dumb like side with him again.

サラミスの王になる資格があるのは
ダヤンさまだってのがうちの親の口癖でしたから……
text.official_en:
They always insisted that Prince Dyan was the only
one qualified to lead Saramis, after all...
text.real_en:
They always insisted that Dayan-sama was the only
one qualified to lead Saramis, after all...

text.jp:
ダヤン様が幽閉されていたコットス要塞は
絶海の孤島とでもいうべき場所です。
text.official_en:
Fort Cottus, where Prince Dyan was imprisoned,
is a lone island far out at sea.
text.real_en:
Fort Cottus, where Dayan-sama was imprisoned,
is a lone island far out at sea.

text.jp:
周囲の潮の流れも速く……過去、あそこから
逃亡を果たしたものはいなかったはずです。
text.official_en:
The currents surrounding it are turbulent. That's why
no one has ever escaped from it before.

時期しか海が鎮まることはないのですが……
text.official_en: The sea only calms for a very short time each year...

勢力が、サラミスの内部にいたということですね……
text.official_en:
My guess is that Prince Dyan still has his supporters
in Saramis who helped him with the timing.
text.real_en:
My guess is that Dayan-sama still has his supporters
